items.title: Novartis projects slowed growth, pins hopes on billions in pipeline potential
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): With Kisqali going off patent and decreasing prices impacting sales, Novartis has narrowed sales guidance to 5% growth. But management remains steadfast that they have a plan to get back on track.

items.title: Actinogen’s sole drug fails pivotal Alzheimer’s study, sinking stock 80%
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Actinogen Medical’s lead program for its sole pipeline candidate has failed a late-stage study, but the Australian biotech still plans on taking the findings to the FDA for a path forward.

items.title: nChroma halves workforce, BioXcel lets execs go
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.

items.title: Regeneron racks up another first as FDA greenlights generalized myasthenia gravis RNA drug
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The go-ahead for Alnylam Pharmaceuticals–licensed Livsayis marks Regeneron’s second new modality this year after the company secured approval for hearing loss gene therapy Otarmeni in April.

items.title: Sanofi secures first FDA approval to treat neurological symptoms in rare metabolic disease
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Sanofi’s Infilbray is designed to cross the blood-brain barrier, allowing the drug to prevent the toxic buildup of disease-causing lipids in the brain for patients with type 3 Gaucher disease.

items.title: The untapped potential of drug repurposing
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): In this episode of Denatured, you'll hear from Daniel Tillett, CEO of Racura Oncology and Sten Sörensen, CEO of Cereno Scientific. We explore why the FDA is now prioritizing drug repurposing, and what it will take to turn existing molecules into viable new therapies.

items.title: AbbVie grooves with DISCO’s solid tumor tech in up to $2.5B licensing deal
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): There’s a party going on at DISCO Pharma’s European headquarters after the precision medicine biotech signed its second major pharma partnership of the year—first Amgen, now AbbVie.

items.title: Sanofi gains FDA clearance for Gaucher disease pill
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The approval culminates a winding development journey for Infilbray, and provides Sanofi with a new source of income ahead of Dupixent’s looming patent expiration.

items.title: China could ‘corner’ biopharma sector with new plan, US panel warns
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): A commission called on U.S. lawmakers to act quickly to prevent an “overdependence” on China that could leave American patients “vulnerable to supply chain weaponization.”

items.title: With FDA nod, Regeneron brings an RNAi drug to autoimmune disease
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The product of a collaboration with Alnylam, Livsayis is now Regeneron’s first marketed RNAi drug and will compete against established medicines from AstraZeneca and Argenx.
